user.title: Cheapest Hour Scheduler
user.description: Choose the price sensor (with prices_today / prices_tomorrow attributes) and how many consecutive hours the cheapest block should be.

data_description.price_sensor: Sensor with prices_today and prices_tomorrow attributes, e.g. sensor.zonneplan_current_tariff_rounded
data_description.block_hours: Length of the cheapest consecutive block. Quarters are allowed (e.g. 2.5).

add_device.title: Add device
add_device.description: Without 'ready by' the device follows the shared cheapest block (plus offset). With 'ready by' it gets its own cheapest window that finishes in time.

data_description.name: Shown everywhere instead of the entity name, e.g. 'Dishwasher'.
data_description.on_value: 'on' for switches; a number for number entities; 'auto' (or text containing {seconds_until_start}) sends the number of seconds until the start, e.g. for number.keuken_dishwasher_start_in_relative.
data_description.off_value: Usually 'off'. Leave empty to do nothing at the end.
data_description.duration_hours: How long it must stay on. Empty = until the end of the block.
data_description.start_offset_minutes: Start this many minutes after the block starts (only without 'ready by').
data_description.ready_by: Time the device must be finished. The device then gets its own cheapest window of 'run time' hours (or the block length) that ends before this time, e.g. 07:00. Empty = follow the shared block.
